title: HANNON HELIXX — Productive Electric Mobility
summary: A proposed USD 5 million electric mobility initiative in Tunisia combining affordable access to productive electric vehicles, rapid battery swapping infrastructure, fleet management, maintenance services and potential local vehicle assembly.
description:
HANNON INTERNATIONAL INVESTISSEMENTS S.A presents a proposed productive electric mobility initiative in Tunisia, focused on improving vehicle access for urban workers, delivery operators, small businesses and the gig economy.

The project combines compact electric utility vehicles, flexible vehicle access solutions, modular battery swapping stations, preventive maintenance and fleet support services.

Its objective is to reduce vehicle acquisition barriers, minimize charging downtime and improve the availability of income-generating electric vehicles.

The development strategy includes an initial pilot program, partnerships with fleet operators and energy infrastructure providers, and the evaluation of local vehicle assembly opportunities.

HANNON welcomes strategic investors, industrial partners, technology providers and mobility operators interested in developing a scalable electric mobility ecosystem in Tunisia.

The initiative remains subject to feasibility studies, commercial agreements, technical validation and regulatory approvals.
sector: Electric Mobility, Battery Swapping, Automotive Assembly & Clean Energy
location: Tunisia — Initial Urban Pilot, Nationwide Expansion Potential

title: HANNON Tunisia Cement & Gypsum Network
summary: A proposed USD 1.5 billion integrated cement, sulfate-resistant clinker and gypsum industrial network in Tunisia, targeting more than 10 million tonnes of annual clinker capacity, renewable energy integration and export development across Europe and Africa.
description:
HANNON INTERNATIONAL INVESTMENTS presents the Tunisia Cement & Gypsum Network, an ambitious industrial initiative designed to develop an integrated construction materials production and export platform.

The project combines limestone and clay resources, premium sulfate-resistant clinker manufacturing, cement production, gypsum extraction, plaster processing and advanced industrial logistics.

Its development strategy emphasizes renewable energy integration, efficient production technologies, reduced carbon intensity and international quality standards.

Target markets include infrastructure development, maritime construction, industrial facilities and construction material distributors across Europe, Africa and the Mediterranean region.

The project aims to establish modern production facilities supported by solar and wind energy, industrial quality control, bulk export terminals and efficient maritime logistics.

HANNON welcomes strategic investors, industrial manufacturers, infrastructure funds, technology providers and international commercial partners.

All investment, capacity, environmental performance and financial targets remain subject to feasibility studies, regulatory approvals, resource verification and definitive agreements.
sector: Cement, Clinker, Gypsum, Construction Materials & Renewable Energy
location: Tunisia — Industrial Production Sites & Mediterranean Export Ports

title: HANNON Green Granary Tunisia
summary: A proposed USD 35 million large-scale agricultural initiative in northern Tunisia, targeting over 5,000 hectares of precision-managed farmland and 22,000 tonnes of annual cereals and oilseed production, supported by mechanization, crop rotation and modern grain storage infrastructure.
description:
HANNON INTERNATIONAL INVESTMENTS presents Green Granary Tunisia, a strategic large-scale agricultural development initiative focused on food security, modern farming and sustainable crop production.

Located in the high-rainfall agricultural regions of Mateur, Bizerte and North-West Tunisia, the project aims to progressively develop more than 5,000 hectares of managed farmland.

Its integrated crop rotation strategy combines durum wheat, barley, canola and faba beans to improve soil fertility, diversify agricultural production and optimize yields.

The project incorporates precision-guided machinery, drones, soil monitoring, conservation agriculture, mechanized harvesting and modern grain storage facilities.

With a target annual output of 22,000 tonnes by Year 5, Green Granary Tunisia seeks to strengthen Tunisia's agricultural productivity and develop an efficient, technology-driven agribusiness platform.

Investment opportunities include strategic equity participation, agricultural joint ventures, mechanization partnerships and grain storage infrastructure financing.

All investment, production and financial targets remain subject to land availability, feasibility studies and agricultural performance.
sector: Large-Scale Agriculture, Cereals, Agritech & Food Security

title: HANNON Phosphate & Advanced Materials
summary: A proposed EUR 250 million integrated phosphate processing and advanced materials complex in Tunisia, targeting 200,000 tonnes of annual fertilizer production, phosphoric acid manufacturing, specialty phosphates and future battery-material applications.
description:
HANNON INTERNATIONAL INVESTMENTS presents a proposed EUR 250 million integrated phosphate processing and advanced materials initiative in Tunisia.

The project aims to establish a modern industrial complex combining qualified phosphate rock supply, phosphoric acid production, fertilizer manufacturing, quality control and international distribution.

The initial production portfolio prioritizes DAP 18-46-0 and granular MAP 11-52-0, with a combined target capacity of 200,000 tonnes annually.

Further development opportunities include purified phosphoric acid, feed phosphates, water-soluble fertilizers, specialty phosphates and iron phosphate precursors for potential lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery applications.

The project incorporates cleaner processing technologies, water recovery, digital operations and a proposed EUR 5 million research and development program.

HANNON welcomes strategic investors, industrial technology partners, phosphate suppliers and international distribution partners.

The project remains at concept stage, and all financial and production targets are subject to feasibility studies, regulatory approvals and definitive agreements.
sector: Phosphate Processing, Fertilizers, Industrial Chemicals & Advanced Materials
location: Tunisia — Gafsa, Gabès & Skhira Industrial Corridor

title: HANNON International Storage & Export Hubs
summary: A USD 15 million international logistics initiative to establish storage, cold-chain and distribution hubs connecting Tunisian exporters with markets across Europe, Africa and the Gulf region.
description:
HANNON INTERNATIONAL INVESTMENTS presents an international warehousing and export distribution initiative designed to connect Tunisian producers with global markets.

The project aims to establish strategically located logistics hubs offering dry storage, refrigerated warehousing, inventory management, order fulfillment, packaging, quality control and international distribution.

Target products include Tunisian olive oil, dates, processed foods, textiles, natural cosmetics and traditional handicrafts.

The business model combines warehouse rental, logistics services, trade intermediation, distribution partnerships and value-added packaging services.

The proposed initial investment will support the development of pilot hubs, with future expansion across Europe, North Africa, Sub-Saharan Africa and the Gulf region.

The initiative welcomes strategic investors, logistics operators, commercial distributors and international joint-venture partners.
sector: International Logistics, Warehousing, Distribution & Export Trade
location: Tunisia, Europe, North Africa, Sub-Saharan Africa & Gulf Region

title: HANNON Marble Extraction & Processing
summary: A USD 12 million integrated marble industry investment initiative combining natural stone quarrying, advanced cutting and polishing technologies, premium architectural products and international export development.
description:
HANNON INTERNATIONAL INVESTMENTS presents an integrated marble extraction and processing initiative designed to transform valuable natural stone resources into premium products for international markets.

The project combines modern quarry operations, diamond-wire extraction, industrial block cutting, precision polishing and high-quality architectural finishing.

Its product portfolio includes marble blocks, polished slabs, luxury flooring, architectural façades, decorative stone and customized interior solutions.

The development strategy emphasizes efficient resource utilization, water recycling, renewable energy integration and sustainable quarry management.

Investment Opportunity: Strategic equity participation, industrial joint ventures, quarry development financing and international distribution partnerships.

Investment figures and production targets remain indicative, subject to geological studies, licensing, feasibility assessments and investment agreements.
sector: Mining, Natural Stone, Industrial Manufacturing & Construction Materials

title: HANNON Tunisia Green Data Hub
summary: An USD 80 million green data center investment initiative in Tunisia, targeting an initial 10 MW facility powered by renewable energy, with planned subsea fiber connectivity to Europe and long-term expansion potential beyond 50 MW.
description:
HANNON INTERNATIONAL INVESTMENTS presents the Tunisia Green Data Hub, an ambitious sustainable digital infrastructure project connecting Europe, North Africa and international cloud markets.

The initiative aims to develop a high-performance, solar-powered data center campus with an initial 10 MW capacity and potential expansion beyond 50 MW.

The project combines renewable energy, advanced cooling systems, resilient digital infrastructure, international subsea fiber connectivity and secure data hosting.

Investment Highlights:USD 80 million proposed initial investment, 10 MW first-phase capacity, planned European connectivity, renewable energy integration and long-term industrial scalability.

Investment Opportunity: Strategic equity participation, infrastructure financing, technology partnerships and international data center joint ventures.

All capacity, connectivity, cost and financial targets remain subject to technical feasibility, regulatory approvals and commercial agreements.
sector: Digital Infrastructure, Data Centers, Renewable Energy & Cloud Computing

title: HANNON Premium Heat Pump & Clean Energy Network
summary: A USD 5 million clean energy investment initiative to establish a nationwide heat pump sales, installation and maintenance network in Tunisia, delivering energy-efficient heating, cooling, hot water and solar-integrated solutions for residential, commercial and industrial customers.
description:
HANNON INTERNATIONAL INVESTMENTS presents a USD 5 million investment initiative to develop a premium national heat pump and clean energy solutions network in Tunisia.

The project offers advanced air-to-air, air-to-water, geothermal, hot water, swimming pool and industrial heat pump systems, complemented by solar energy integration.

Its business model combines equipment sales, professional installation, maintenance contracts and technical services to generate recurring revenue.

**Investment Highlights:** 30% target gross margin, 20% indicative ROI, 3-year target break-even and nationwide expansion.

Investment Opportunity: Equity participation, strategic industrial partnerships, technology transfer and distribution agreements.

All financial and performance targets are indicative and subject to feasibility studies, technology validation and investment agreements.
sector: Renewable Energy, Heat Pumps, HVAC & Energy Efficiency

title: HANNON Camel Bioeconomy & Agro-Industrial Development
summary: A landmark EUR 3 billion international investment initiative dedicated to developing an integrated camel-based bioeconomy in Tunisia. The 10-year programme aims to progressively relocate up to 1.5 million dromedaries from Australia and establish six specialized industrial hubs covering camel dairy and meat production, genetics, biotechnology, sustainable agriculture, renewable energy, and scientific research.
description:
HANNON Camel Bioeconomy & Agro-Industrial Development

A landmark EUR 3 billion investment programme aiming to transform Tunisia into a global hub for camel-based bioeconomy, biotechnology and sustainable agro-industrial development.

The 10-year project targets the progressive relocation of up to 1.5 million dromedaries from Australia and the establishment of six integrated hubs covering dairy and meat production, breeding and genetics, biotechnology, sustainable agriculture, renewable energy, and scientific research.

Investment Highlights:

- Total Investment: EUR 3 billion
- Initial Funding: EUR 500 million
- Projected Annual Revenue: EUR 1.45 billion by Year 10
- Indicative Payback: 6.2 years

Investment Opportunities: Equity participation, joint ventures and strategic industrial partnerships.

All targets and projections are indicative, subject to feasibility studies and regulatory approvals.

title: HANNON AI Profiling & Human Potential Platform
summary: An innovative AI-powered psychological profiling and career intelligence platform designed to identify individual strengths, assess cognitive abilities and provide personalized academic, professional and talent development recommendations.
description:
HANNON AI Profiling is an innovative digital platform combining psychological science, cognitive assessment and explainable artificial intelligence to unlock human potential.

The platform evaluates personality traits, skills, motivations and professional interests to deliver personalized educational pathways, career recommendations and development strategies.

Serving individuals, universities, businesses and employment institutions, the project offers scalable B2C subscriptions, B2B SaaS licensing, enterprise integration and premium advisory services.

Investment Vision: Build a multilingual international platform connecting human capabilities with educational and professional opportunities across Africa, the Middle East and global markets.

The project prioritizes scientific validation, data privacy, fairness and qualified human oversight.
sector: Artificial Intelligence, EdTech, HRTech & Psychological Assessment

title: HANNON Advanced Technologies
summary: An EUR 8 million advanced technology investment initiative in Tunisia, integrating robotics, civilian drones, nanotechnology and applied R&D to accelerate industrial innovation, technology transfer and high-value manufacturing.
description:
HANNON Advanced Technologies is an ambitious EUR 8 million investment initiative designed to establish an advanced industrial innovation and technology integration platform in Tunisia.

The project focuses on three strategic sectors:

1. Robotics & Intelligent Automation: Industrial robots, smart manufacturing, logistics automation, healthcare robotics and intelligent systems integration.

2. Drones & Autonomous Systems:Civilian drones for precision agriculture, infrastructure inspection, environmental monitoring and emergency response.

3. Nanotechnology & Advanced Materials: Research in advanced materials, medical diagnostics, energy storage, electronics and innovative industrial applications.

The programme also promotes applied research, technology transfer, local engineering capabilities and partnerships with international technology providers, universities and industrial groups.

Investment Vision: Develop a competitive Tunisian technology ecosystem serving African, European and Middle Eastern markets through innovation, industrial services and advanced manufacturing.

Financial projections are indicative and subject to feasibility studies and investment agreements.

title: HANNON Tunisia Lithium & Battery Initiative
summary: An innovative industrial initiative to explore Tunisia's lithium-bearing brines and develop advanced lithium extraction, battery assembly and energy storage technologies through a phased investment programme.
description:
HANNON INTERNATIONAL INVESTMENTS presents an integrated lithium and battery development initiative in Tunisia, combining mineral resource exploration, innovative extraction technologies and advanced battery manufacturing.

The project follows a phased industrial strategy covering lithium resource validation, pilot extraction, battery pack assembly, quality testing and future manufacturing expansion.

With an indicative long-term investment programme of EUR 12 million, the initiative seeks an initial USD 800,000 investment to support technical feasibility, laboratory testing, engineering studies and strategic industrial partnerships.

The long-term vision includes a proposed 100 MWh annual battery pack assembly capacity, serving electric mobility, renewable energy storage, robotics, agriculture and industrial applications.

Investment Opportunity:Participation in an emerging Tunisian battery value chain with opportunities for international technology transfer, industrial partnerships and scalable manufacturing.

All resource estimates, production capacities and financial projections remain subject to independent verification and feasibility studies.
sector: Mining, Lithium, Battery Technology & Energy Storage
